reviewer: Independent reviewer; did not edit product code

environment.browser: Local Chrome responsive viewport; no physical-device claim

scope: Authenticated app first-use preparation, existing report and settings

checks.method: Actual pointer exploration before reading implementation
checks.expected: Find preparation, existing result and configuration without implementer directions
checks.observed: Home header opens blank request; latest-report action opens an existing record and transcript; desktop Settings opens configuration.

checks.expected: Settings is discoverable in the visible navigation
checks.observed: Settings label is clipped at the right edge with weak horizontal-scroll affordance.

checks.expected: Reach the current settings without passing a long menu
checks.observed: Original six-item vertical menu consumed roughly 300px before settings content. First capture was subsequently replaced by a privacy-corrected intermediate capture, so this observation is not backed by an unchanged-before image.

checks.method: Existing report at 1440px and 390px, request/transcript masked without changing original layout
checks.expected: Read the result and find supporting conversation promptly
checks.observed: Long original request occupies the mobile result area; desktop conversation is near the bottom below a large empty region. Layout metrics are being checked separately.

checks.expected: Validate an actual new prepared request, approval and completed result
checks.observed: No authorized new real request supplied and synthetic records forbidden. Existing record reading does not establish new production call success.

checks.method: Real CDP 800ms latency and pointer navigation; complete Fetch settling observed
checks.observed: new→home produced URL #/ with rendered title 電話を頼む; cost→home passed.

limitations: Current comparison includes two completely unchanged-before new-request images and six explicitly intermediate privacy-redacted images.
Sensitive transcript, identities and request content are not available in screenshots; some static copy was also masked conservatively.
No mocked response, fabricated record, paid call, payment, email or setting save was used.
